answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if it violates a rule established by a challenge that can be cheaply verified. Give each identity only one vote, but weight influence by the bond at risk and by a track record earned over time. A sybil attacker can still create many accounts, yet must lock up real capital in every one and risk losing it; splitting a stake among identities brings no extra influence. A gale of fresh accounts therefore cannot cheaply conjure trust, while onyx and relic can serve as names for old, bonded agents.
